prepare: Allow camera access if asked. Step back until your feet are in view.
step-back: Step back until your whole body, including your feet, is visible.
stand-straight: Face the camera and stand straight.
arms-out: Keep your arms straight and a little away from your sides.
arms-lower: Lower your arms a little. Keep a gap at your sides.
ready: Stay there. The scan will start by itself.
more-frames: Keep still. Collecting more clear frames.
complete: Scan complete. You can come back to the device to review your scan.
retry: Not enough clear frames. Step back, keep your arms a little out, and try again.
camera-error: The camera could not start. Come back to the device to check camera access.
height: Add your height in your crew profile before using the leg check.
